headline: AIMIA
Lab
intro: Our research focuses on embodied intelligence, multimodal intelligence and AI for Science (AI4S).

directions.title: Embodied intelligence
directions.description: Exploring a hierarchical architecture with an agent planner and either a native-action agent or a VLA model, connecting task planning, action execution and environment feedback.
directions.question: How can an agent planner collaborate with native-action agents or VLA models to act in the physical world?

directions.title: Multimodal intelligence
directions.description: Understanding and generating content across vision and language, including images, videos and human motion.
directions.question: How can models understand and generate content across visual and language modalities?

directions.title: AI for Science (AI4S)
directions.description: Developing AI methods for biomolecular prediction and design, virus evolution, protein structure and medical image analysis.
directions.question: How can AI support scientific prediction and discovery in biology and medicine?
